title: File Handling
description: Learn to read, write, and manage files in Python.
learning_objectives: Understand file modes and text encoding.

sections.title: Opening Files
sections.markdown: To work with files, you must use the `open` function which returns a file object.
key_points: Opening Files is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Opening in real code

sections.title: File Modes
sections.markdown: Different modes like 'r' (read), 'w' (write), 'a' (append) specify how you intend to use the file.
key_points: File Modes is a core concept to understand
Practice applying File in real code

sections.title: Reading Files
sections.markdown: You can read the entire file using `.read()`, or iterate over lines, or use `.readlines()`.
key_points: Reading Files is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Reading in real code

sections.title: Writing Files
sections.markdown: Writing involves opening in write or append mode and using `.write()` to read write content.
key_points: Writing Files is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Writing in real code

sections.title: With Context Manager
sections.markdown: The `with` statement ensures the file is properly closed after its suite finishes, even if exceptions are raised.
key_points: With Context Manager is a core concept to understand
Practice applying With in real code

sections.title: Text Encoding
sections.markdown: Always specify text encoding explicitly, usually `encoding='utf-8'`, to avoid platform-dependent bugs.
key_points: Text Encoding is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Text in real code

sections.title: Pathlib Basics
sections.markdown: The `pathlib` module provides an object-oriented interface for paths, making path manipulation easier than os.path.
key_points: Pathlib Basics is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Pathlib in real code

sections.title: Reading JSON
sections.markdown: The `json` module provides `json.load()` to read JSON data directly from a file object.
key_points: Reading JSON is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Reading in real code

sections.title: Writing JSON
sections.markdown: Similarly, `json.dump()` writes Python dictionaries directly into files as JSON.
key_points: Writing JSON is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Writing in real code

sections.title: CSV Basics
sections.markdown: The `csv` module is used for reading and writing CSV formats.
key_points: CSV Basics is a core concept to understand
Practice applying CSV in real code

sections.title: Error Handling with Files
sections.markdown: Proper error handling using try-except blocks is crucial for handling missing files or permission issues.
key_points: Error Handling with Files is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Error in real code

sections.title: Interview Points
sections.markdown: Interviewers will expect you to use `with` statements naturally and know the difference between string and bytes.
key_points: Interview Points is a core concept to understand
Practice applying Interview in real code
